integrity: A complete analytic argument gives exact vector and scalar recurrences and asymptotic limits. A standalone verifier checks symbolic identities and representative finite-dimensional cases. Historical priority is qualified by inaccessible full texts; no independent audit has been undertaken.
limitations: The all-dimensional result is restricted to a fixed inconsistent least-squares system with equal-norm orthogonal columns and relaxation in [1,2); it does not analyze the double/triple extended normal-equation solvers, random row sampling, sparse/proximal variants, or independent refreshed noise.
title: Relaxation bifurcation and false two-cycles of residual surrogate-hyperplane projection
